% amsmath's \displaybreak, \allowdisplaybreaks, and \hidewidth in math,
% which MathJax lacks. \displaybreak and \allowdisplaybreaks only allow a
% page break, and \hidewidth only lets a cell stick out, so none of them
% shows on the page. \displaybreak before \\ in align, with its optional
% argument from [0] to [4], on a numbered row with a \label, after the row
% end in gather*, in multline, alignat, flalign*, and eqnarray, in a
% theorem, and in align*, with an \eqref to rows that have it. Then
% \allowdisplaybreaks and \allowdisplaybreaks[2] inside a display, and
% \allowdisplaybreaks[1] in the preamble. Then \hidewidth at the start of
% a matrix cell, at the end of an array cell, in pmatrix, bmatrix, and
% cases, in smallmatrix in inline math and in a footnote, and on both
% sides of a cell of a text tabular, which tex4ht sets outside MathJax.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amsthm}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\allowdisplaybreaks[1]
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\section{Breaks}
\begin{align}
a &= b \displaybreak \\
c &= d
\end{align}
\begin{align}
e &= f \label{eq:two} \displaybreak[3] \\
g &= h \displaybreak[0] \\
i &= j \displaybreak[1] \\
k &= l \displaybreak[2] \\
m &= n \displaybreak[4] \\
o &= p
\end{align}
See \eqref{eq:two} and \ref{eq:two}.
\begin{gather*}
x + y \\ \displaybreak[0]
z
\end{gather*}
\begin{multline}
q + r + s \displaybreak \\
= t
\end{multline}
\begin{alignat}{2}
u &= v &\quad w &= y \displaybreak[2] \\
A &= B & C &= D
\end{alignat}
\begin{flalign*}
E &= F \displaybreak \\
G &= H
\end{flalign*}
\begin{eqnarray}
I & = & J \label{eq:arr} \displaybreak \\
K & = & L
\end{eqnarray}
\begin{theorem}
\begin{align}
M &= N \label{eq:thm} \displaybreak \\
O &= P
\end{align}
\end{theorem}
\begin{align*}
Q &= R \displaybreak \\
S &= T
\end{align*}
Rows \eqref{eq:arr} and \eqref{eq:thm}.
\begin{align}
\allowdisplaybreaks
U &= V \\
W &= X
\end{align}
\begin{align*}
\allowdisplaybreaks[2]
Y &= Z \\
\alpha &= \beta
\end{align*}
\section{Widths}
\[
\begin{matrix} \hidewidth a \\ bbb \end{matrix}
\qquad
\begin{array}{c} ccc\hidewidth \\ d \end{array}
\qquad
\begin{pmatrix} \hidewidth e & f \\ ggg & h \end{pmatrix}
\qquad
\begin{bmatrix} kkk & \hidewidth l \hidewidth \\ m & nnn \end{bmatrix}
\]
\[
|x| = \begin{cases} \hidewidth x & x \ge 0 \\ -x & x < 0 \end{cases}
\]
Inline $\begin{smallmatrix} \hidewidth o \\ ppp \end{smallmatrix}$ and in
a note.\footnote{A note $\begin{smallmatrix} qqq\hidewidth \\ r \end{smallmatrix}$.}
